name: Kuro
source:
[Captain]
A pale, gaunt young girl with disproportionately large, bulging eyes—famously dubbed "the Captain who summons storms."

Though she claims the title of Captain, her mental state is usually quite pitiable (her cognitive faculties become sluggish, and she often loses the ability to distinguish even left from right).

She is mocked not only by the core crew of the *Albatross* but even by the lowest-ranking sailors.

They force her to play word-chain games to relieve their own stress and treat her like a menial laborer; she displays absolutely none of the qualities one would expect of a captain.
However, when the atmospheric pressure drops significantly—such as before a massive tempest—
a "switch" in her brain clicks into place, granting her god-like intelligence and an extraordinary capacity for command.

It is precisely this that has allowed the *Albatross* to survive violent storms—the kind that would surely sink any other vessel—to this very day.
Yet, the crew believes the exact opposite: they are convinced that the storms only occur *because* the Captain’s "switch" has been flipped. Consequently, she never receives a shred of gratitude.

When they threaten her—"If you summon another storm, we’ll toss you into the sea to replace Souemon!"—she bursts into genuine, inconsolable tears.
And yet, in truth, the entire crew is deeply fond of their Captain.

Deep down, she even harbors a vague wish: "If only there were a sea where a storm was always raging—a place where I could stay sharp and intelligent all the time..."
